_doc: The one shared file for movement and feel numbers (owner 2026-11-08). One section per system; each value says its unit in its key or note. Read through Tuning.of(section).

meeko._note: Meeko's sun and moon (PipOrbit, owner item 24): metres on the class-neutral model (they scale with her), Hz = turns or cycles a second, rate in 1/s. They circle lift_m above her hips at radius_m, sun and moon on opposite sides; on the side in front of her or toward the camera they sink clear_dip_m and swing clear_push_m wider. lag_rate: how fast they catch up when she moves (trail = speed / rate), never more than lag_max_m behind. A cast (any of her moves starting) speeds the orbit and spin by the cast_*_k factors, pops them cast_pop_m out and flares the glow by cast_flare, all fading over cast_s. glow: a soft ball glow_r_m round each, alpha glow_a pulsing by +-pulse at pulse_hz.
